flash.name: 절광발도
flash.prompt: Make a premium painterly 2D side-scrolling action RPG VFX flipbook. EXACTLY four columns and two rows, 8 sequential evolving animation cels, one isolated effect centered in each equal rectangular cell, generous empty gutter at least 10% inside every cell, transparent RGBA, no lettering, numbers, borders, floor, scenery, character or weapon-wielder. The 8 images are a temporal sequence: first very small, opening motion, accelerating, explosive broad peak at cel 4 and 5, then tear apart, ribbon aftermath, ending with a few faint slivers. Extremely sharp Japanese sword master art direction: an opaque ink-black cutting plane, brushed silver steel facets, sharp luminous ivory leading edge, controlled champagne-gold glints, strong dark negative spaces. Crisp hand-painted hatching, long lightning-fast sword-edge streaks, thin metal shavings, zero flowers, petals, botanical shapes, sigils, runes, elemental magic, fire, generic circular explosions or pastel clouds. Draw authentic, elaborate game VFX readable at thumbnail size. Transparent gutters that actually separate all artwork. Specific cut: A sudden hooked rising crescent of polished sword light. Shape begins as a small precise glint, opens rightwards as a pair of long knife-thin horizontal draw lines, then snaps into ONE large upswept, sharply bent, silver-white crescent with a shadow-black scabbard-shaped gap and shattered gold grazing sparks hugging its edge. Its trailing side unravels into fine parallel steel hairs. Asymmetric reverse hook, high diagonal finish, side view.
